name: smartdrive-3d-suite
description: SMARTDRIVE 3D — Real-Time Vehicle Distance Monitoring & Collision Warning System

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: npx concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm test --prefix frontend
